name: Holvek MA-2 Bomber
description:
A civilian reinterpretation of the classic military bomber silhouette — ribbed cuffs and hem, a front zip, slash pockets, and a clean nylon shell in olive, black, or a deep brick red. Holvek is a mid-sized manufacturer based in the Tier 3 commercial district that does honest, unfussy work. The MA-2 is their best-selling jacket by a wide margin. It's not exciting. It fits well, it doesn't cost too much, and it comes in twelve colors.

The lining is a quilted synthetic insulation that handles Chicago-corridor winters without drama. No tech, no gimmicks. Students, young office workers, and service-sector employees wear it because it looks put-together without announcing any particular affiliation. It's the jacket equivalent of a firm handshake.
what_it_says: You're practical and presentable. You don't need your jacket to make a statement.
story_hooks: The same jacket in the same color is worn by four different people at a crime scene — none of them know each other, and none of them know why they're there.
A limited run of the MA-2 was accidentally shipped with an RFID tag that tracks to a classified corponation logistics node.
A Tier 1 knockoff of the MA-2 is circulating in the Shelf — identical in appearance but the lining contains contraband sewn into flat packets.

physical_description.visual_profile: A streamlined bomber with classic military DNA—structured shoulders, tapered waist, and a cropped length that hits at the hip. The silhouette reads authoritative but approachable: neither corpo-sleek nor street-worn. On-body, it projects quiet competence and understated functionality.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not restrictive—a modern relaxed fit through the chest and shoulders with subtle suppression at the waist. Sleeve length is precise to the wrist. The quilted lining adds subtle volume without bulk. Cut for layering over casual or business-casual wear.
physical_description.primary_material: Durable nylon shell with a matte finish. The lining is synthetic quilted insulation—lightweight, quick-drying, temperature-regulating for GLMZ winters without the weight of traditional down.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost slick nylon exterior with a subtle sheen under urban lighting. Ribbed cotton-blend cuffs and hem have a slight grip texture. The quilted interior is soft, with fine diamond-stitch quilting visible when unzipped.
physical_description.color_scheme: Offered in twelve colorways including olive drab, matte black, and deep brick red. The model shown features a neutral olive base with charcoal ribbed accents at cuffs, collar, and hem. No logos or visible branding.
physical_description.closures: Full-length heavy-duty metal tooth zipper with a simple pull tab. Two slash pockets with hidden magnetic closures for a clean, uninterrupted front face.
distinctive_features: Ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and hem—traditional bomber DNA translated to modern materials
Vertical welt pockets (slash design) with interior reinforcement
Diamond-quilted synthetic lining visible at zipper and cuffs
Tapered sleeve with precise length—no bulk at wrists
Minimal branding; only small Holvek tag sewn into interior neck
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional. Honest manufacturing, accessible pricing (Φ180-220 range), no surplus material or artificial scarcity. Built to last, not to impress.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by students, junior office staff, service-sector workers, and anyone navigating GLMZ's working-class throughways. It signals reliability and pragmatism—someone who values function over narrative. Agnostic to affiliation: corpo-adjacent but not corporate, street-familiar but not street-affiliated.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but never shabby. After a season or two, the nylon develops a subtle patina; edges soften slightly. Well-maintained examples show no pilling, though heavy use produces creasing at elbows and collar. Genuine wear reads as trustworthiness.
